messages.english: Check an NWS reference for a saved US point.
messages.translation: Hlola ireferensi ye-NWS yephuzu le-US elilondoloziwe.

messages.english: Send a coarsened point for a weather reference
messages.translation: Thumela iphuzu elilinganiselwe ukuze uthole ireferensi yesimo sezulu

messages.english: Crop planner → Site country and region → NWS reference for this saved point
messages.translation: Umhleli wezitshalo → Izwe nendawo yesiza → Ireferensi ye-NWS yaleli phuzu elilondoloziwe

messages.english: For a site saved with a US country description, explicitly send its coordinates rounded to four decimal places to NWS. The Washington demo stays separate. These reference values do not change crop advice or planning dates. Changing the site or account withdraws the display; a request already sent upstream may continue.
messages.translation: Kwisiza esilondolozwe nencazelo yezwe ye-US, thumela ngokusobala izixhumanisi zaso eziqoqwe ezindaweni ezine zedesimali ku-NWS. Idemo yase-Washington ihlala yodwa. Lawa manani ereferensi awashintshi izeluleko zezitshalo noma izinsuku zokuhlela. Ukushintsha isiza noma i-akhawunti kuhoxisa ukuboniswa; isicelo esivele sithunyelwe phezulu singaqhubeka.
